📖 How to use

  1. Enter the total fence length in feet.
  2. Set post spacing (8 ft is standard) and picket width.
  3. Read the posts, pickets and rails to buy.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many posts do I need?

One per section plus one for the end: fence length ÷ post spacing, rounded up, plus 1.

What picket spacing does this assume?

Tight, side-by-side pickets with no gap (privacy style). For spaced picket fences, add your gap to the picket width mentally or buy fewer.

How deep should posts be set?

About one-third of the post length underground — typically 2 ft deep for a 6 ft fence, set in concrete.
